
# **Tipping Study - pt.2 Clean & prep data**

---

Setup
---

#### Workspace
```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(gsignal)
```

#### Data
```{r}
load(here::here("data", "proc", "01_out.rdata"))
```


Smooth
---

Data dual-passed through a 4th order dual low-pass Butterworth filter
A 6 Hz cutoff was chosen as apparently the bio-machinists are fond of it.

Smoothing quality visually checked in appendices/check_smoothing.r
Values chosen because the bio-mechs say so.

#### Run butterworth
```{r}
filt_order <- 4
samp <- 120
cutoff <- 6
nyq <- samp / 2
wn <- cutoff / nyq

buttbutt <- butter(
  n = filt_order, w = wn, type = "low", output = "Sos"
)

to_smooth <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

grp_n <- uniqueN(dt, c("trial_num", "block_num", "participant_id"))

for (col in to_smooth) {
  # first time I ever thought a progress bar would be handy
  pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = grp_n, style = 3)
  dt[,
    (paste0(col, "_smooth")) := {
      setTxtProgressBar(pb, .GRP)
      gsignal::filtfilt(buttbutt, get(col))
    },
    by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num)
  ]
}
```

###### Translate

Initial positions set as origin points

```{r}
mkr_cols <- grep("_x|_y|_z", colnames(dt))

dt[, (mkr_cols) := lapply(.SD, \(mkr) mkr <- mkr - mkr[1]),
  by = .(participant_id, trial_num, block_num),
  .SDcols = mkr_cols
]
```


###### Drop rough data

```{r}
# add _raw to pre-smoothed columns
raw_cols <- grep("_x$|_y$|_z$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
setnames(dt, raw_cols, paste0(raw_cols, "_raw"))

# drop _smooth from smoothed
smoothed_cols <- grep("_smooth$", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
setnames(dt, smoothed_cols, gsub("_smooth", "", smoothed_cols))
```


###### Get hand position

Five markers used to track hand, (for now) treating the avg to represent hand pos

```{r}
lapply( # TODO: redo but less brutish
  c("x", "y", "z"),
  \(axis) {
    cols <- grep(paste0("_", axis, "$"), colnames(dt), value = TRUE)
    dt[, paste0("hand_", axis) := rowMeans(.SD), .SDcols = cols]
  }
)
```
